_documentation: A curated Bluesky thread for the social pipeline (scripts/social-post.py --thread FILE). Each post is verbatim text, posted in order, each replying to the previous (root + parent strong refs). @handle.tld tokens in the text become mention facets (the handle is resolved to a DID live, at post time); http(s) URLs become link facets; both use UTF-8 byte offsets. The first post may carry an image (PNG or JPEG). The `key` is recorded in data/social-posted.json after a successful run so an approved workflow cannot double-post the thread. Bluesky only for now; LinkedIn threading is a separate concern. Compose/verify with `--dry-run` (default); publish with `--live` behind the `social` environment approval gate.

🏆 Congratulations to the winners of the European Security Studies Best Paper Prize, awarded in partnership with the Journal of Strategic Studies!

▫️Anna Seliverstova (Linnaeus University)

▫️Mattia Sguazzini (University of Genova)

posts.text:
📄 Winning papers:

🏆 Anna Seliverstova: "Telegram in Russia's Information Strategy: Evidence from Serbia"

🏆 Mattia Sguazzini (@mattiasguazzini.bsky.social): "Do Parliaments Dream of Cyber Power? Parliamentary Scrutiny in the Strategic Domain of Cyberspace"

The awards were presented during last week's European Security Studies Conference, co-organised by @eissnetwork.bsky.social, NetSec, and @stockholm-uni.bsky.social

Congratulations once again to both winners, and thank you to everyone who helped make the inaugural conference such a success!
